chapter: Russell and Armstrong years, Goodman and the road
title: Luis Russell years into Armstrong's band, to 1940
summary: He was with Russell 1929-31, then Armstrong took over the band; he stayed till 1940, then Cafe Society with Red Allen.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: One of the things that I was very interested in was the time that you were playing with Luis Russell's band and with Louis Armstrong, when Pops was conducting, was in front of the band because like that seems like that was a very important time in your life. That was in the '30s?
wasn't it? I know I read somewhere, matter of fact in this book you just gave me here I was reading it says that you played with Luis Russell from 1929 to 1931. Is that true?
But, then you played with Luis Russell longer than that. You left the band in '31?

And played with Louis Armstrong. Went from Russell to Armstrong. Armstrong took over Luis Russell's band. He conducted the band until he got ready to fire Luis Russell and then he fired him (inaudible). So I stayed on with Louis until 1940. Then New Years we went down to Cafe Society with Red Allen downtown.

You've made a lot of records with the band, Pop's band at that time and I was listening to some of the things like I Double Dare You. You took a solo on that -- it's fantastic. As well as the things that you did like the band that Pops had where you recorded When The Saints Go Marching In.
But, I like By and By best.
